Official menu enumerates baos, bowls, sides, sweets, and drinks; it explicitly names ingredients including egg, sesame, almond, tofu, and shrimp.
Linked Toast catalog identifies Bao Bei Castle at 12015 E Rockville Pike, Rockville, MD 20852 and enumerates current combos, menu items, catering, and nonalcoholic drinks.
Accessible listing provides partial corroboration only; it is not used as a complete boundary.
